name: The Legend of Ika Takozushi
source:
Introducing the legendary warrior Ika Takozushi and his faithful companion Ton Katsu. In this story, Ika and Ton face the dreaded General Uni Donburi and have a most unusual experience in the village of Edamame!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/19980111034450/http://otakuworld.com/shibai/]Otaku World[/url]]
